item.title: Show HN: gbx -- manage a fleet of git repos with a TUI
item.summary: hey. I've built this small TUI app to help with managing a fleet of git repos. I am aware of tools like gita, but I wanted something more visual. Would love to receive feedback about usability and missing features. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49243143 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
